race.comment: BISMARCK (2) was a BM56 winner at Ballarat Synthetic two back, since running well in a maiden hurdle. Back to the flat here but will be rock-hard fit and can certainly figure in what looks a very winnable race. THREE REEL ROSES (13) can mix form but has claims on the win at Moe two back, battling away late for fifth at Murtoa since. Drawn wide but can roll forward and outrun her odds. MOTIVER (12) hasn't fired this time in but is better than that form and could improve from a good draw over what looks his best trip. TRUMP CARD (5) comes to the Leek yard from Queensland and has the form to be competitive, watch the market off a freshen.
